operation: Deterministic reconstruction of one actual unchanged-architecture PTH from independently trained heads sharing identical body and auxiliary tensors; no gradient fitting

head_selection.rhythm: Highest source-mean fixed-nine macro-F1 among eligible phase8 candidates, ties lexicographic name
head_selection.pathology: Highest Primary5 macro-F1 among phase8 candidates, ties lexicographic name
head_selection.chronology: Method specified after phase8 validation analysis and before new composed-model evaluation; not retrospectively declared a phase8 trial

architecture.shared_state: All body, buffers, quality and biometric tensors must be bitwise identical across head sources

data.reuse: Same immutable source tensors and references

selection.joint_metric: source mean fixed-nine macro-F1 + 0.5 * Primary5 macro-F1

execution: CEDIA Slurm GPU inference; verify actual composed outputs against both source heads; verify deterministic reconstruction; only then load evaluation targets
